facts.fact: The article cites a belief that by the end of 2020 the number of properly disclosed #ads on Instagram will reach 6.1 million (third-party Wired source).
facts.quote: It’s believed that by the end of 2020 the number of properly disclosed #ads on Instagram will reach 6,1 million

facts.fact: EduBirdie's YouTube ads were brief shout-outs lasting 10 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: the ads were brief (10 to 30 seconds shout-outs)

facts.fact: YouTube personality Zias had 3.1 million subscribers when promoting EduBirdie on their channel.
facts.quote: Zias (with 3.1 million subscribers) promoting EduBirdie on their YouTube channel

facts.fact: EduBirdie's ads were found to violate YouTube's Academic Aid policy, leading YouTube to take down hundreds of videos mentioning the company.
facts.quote: EduBirdie’s ads were violating YouTube’s Academic Aid policy.

facts.fact: According to a blogger quoted in the article, PayPal claimed that since April 4, 2019 it would no longer provide payment services to essay writing companies.
facts.quote: since April 4, 2019, PayPal itself has claimed that it will no longer be providing services to essay writing companies

facts.fact: Fiji Water's campaign used Instagram influencer Danielle Bernstein, who had 2.2 million followers.
facts.quote: instagram influencer Danielle Bernstein (2.2 million followers)
